newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bill rises to 5.49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bill rises to 5.49 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills rose to 5.49 percent from 5.47 percent last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price dropped to 98.630 from 98.636 a week earlier and the minimum price accepted was 98.629.
Banks submitted bids for 24.7 million dinars worth of bills, down from 34.1 million dinars the previous week.
The bills are offered on Monday and issued on Wednesday.
